(()=>{const a=document.querySelector('.live-assistant'),r=a.getBoundingClientRect(),h=document.querySelector('.live-assistant-header');if(Math.abs(r.right-(innerWidth-16))>1)throw Error('Right default missing');if(getComputedStyle(h).color!=='rgb(40, 48, 58)')throw Error('Silver palette ink missing');if(document.querySelector('.assistant-permission input').checked)throw Error('Edits enabled by default');return {right:r.right,top:r.top,header:getComputedStyle(h).backgroundImage}})()

(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('.live-assistant').getBoundingClientRect();if(Math.abs(r.right-(innerWidth-28))>1)throw Error('Dragged position not retained');if(!document.querySelector('.live-assistant-panel'))document.querySelector('.live-assistant-launcher').click();return 'Saved v2 position retained'})()

(()=>{const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-skill-list button')];if(buttons.length!==9)throw Error('Missing runtime skills');buttons.find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Check takeoff readiness')).click();return 'Selected evidence workflow'})()
(()=>{if(!document.querySelector('.live-assistant textarea').value.includes('two-point calibration'))throw Error('Skill not inserted');return 'Evidence workflow ready for user review'})()

(()=>{const panel=document.querySelector('.live-assistant'),r=panel.getBoundingClientRect();if(Math.abs(r.right-(innerWidth-16))>1||r.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Tablet placement');for(const b of panel.querySelectorAll('button,input[type=checkbox]')){const box=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(!box.width||!box.height)continue;if(b.type!=='checkbox'&&(box.width<44||box.height<44))throw Error('Small target '+b.ariaLabel);if(box.left<0||box.right>innerWidth||box.top<0||box.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Clipped control '+b.ariaLabel)}if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Overflow');return 'Tablet bounds and touch targets pass'})()
